              "content": "# TradingAgents WebUI Permission Model\n\nStatus: **Approved for documentation by the human owner on 2026-11-05.** Implementation still requires `[safety-approved]` and `[governance-approved]` where applicable. This document defines the WebUI runtime permission boundary and its relationship to the coding-agent roles.\n\n## 1. Scope\n\nThis model covers:\n\n1. What the browser, web service, run coordinator, artifact reader, and core may do.\n2. Which data classes may cross which boundary.\n3. Which actions require explicit confirmation.\n4. How the coding-agent roles in `.opencode/permissions.jsonc` relate to the product boundary.\n\nIt does not replace the OS sandbox, the OpenCode permission configuration, or a human approval decision.\n\n## 2. Subjects and ownership\n\n| Subject | Owns | May read | May write | May execute |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Browser SPA | Presentation state | Same-origin API responses | Browser local storage only | No server code |\n| FastAPI HTTP layer | Request parsing, validation, error mapping | Request body, config projection | HTTP response | No arbitrary command |\n| Run coordinator | Active run record, worker future, cancel event, event buffer | Validated run request, graph state | Run record, event buffer, run artifacts through the writer | Calls existing Python APIs |\n| Graph runner | One `TradingAgentsGraph` instance | Core config and state | Graph/checkpoint/decision-log through existing methods | Runs the analysis graph |\n| Artifact read model | Read-only index cache | Allowlisted artifact roots | Nothing | No |\n| Backtest runner | One backtest invocation | Backtest request, isolated run dir | Backtest log through `run_backtest` | Calls existing backtest |\n| Core (`tradingagents`) | Business rules, ratings, data access, memory, checkpoints | Its own config/data | Its own artifacts | Existing behaviour only |\n| CLI (`cli`) | Terminal interaction | Core API, prefs | CLI files/artifacts | Existing behaviour only |\n| Operator | Server process, environment | Server logs and artifacts | Environment, filesystem | Starts/stops the server |\n\n## 3. Runtime permission matrix\n\n| Action | Browser | Web API | Coordinator | Artifact reader | Core/CLI |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Read effective config | via API, redacted | allow | read | — | source |\n| Read provider key value | **deny** | **deny** | **deny** | — | server env only |\n| Read key status | allow | allow | — | — | — |\n| Start analysis | allow | allow if validated | allow if no active run | — | — |\n| Start backtest | allow | allow if validated | allow if no active run | — | — |\n| Cancel analysis | allow | allow | allow | — | — |\n| Cancel backtest | **deny** (no route) | **deny** | **deny** | — | no hook |\n| Read live run state | allow | allow | own | — | — |\n| Read history | allow | allow | — | allow | — |\n| Delete/rename history | **deny** | **deny** | **deny** | **deny** | — |\n| Download report | allow via id | allow via id | — | allow | writer source |\n| Accept server path | **deny** | **deny** | **deny** | **deny** | — |\n| Clear all checkpoints | allow with confirmation | allow with confirmation | allow if idle | — | clear method |\n| Place an order | **deny** | **deny** | **deny** | — | **deny** |\n| Change agent/prompt/rating rules | **deny** | **deny** | **deny** | — | out of scope |\n| Write `.env` / keys | **deny** | **deny** | **deny** | — | CLI only, not web |\n\n## 4. Data classification\n\n| Class | Examples | Allowed destinations | Prohibited destinations |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Secret | Provider API keys, tokens, cookies, authorization headers | Server process environment and provider SDK | Browser, events, logs, reports, downloads, errors, snapshots |\n| Internal path | `results_dir`, `data_cache_dir`, `memory_log_path`, absolute paths | Server code and redacted logs | Browser responses, events, errors, downloads |\n| User data | Ticker, date, portfolio, selected models | Browser ↔ API, run artifacts | Third-party services beyond the configured model/data providers |\n| Model/external text | Reports, tool output, announcements | Sanitized rendering and stored artifacts | Executable HTML, server-side evaluation, permission decisions |\n| Run metadata | Run id, status, rating, review flag, timestamps | Browser and artifacts | — |\n| History artifact | Report sections, decision log entries | Read-only browser view and downloads | Mutation by the web layer |\n\n## 5. Permission boundary enforcement\n\n| Boundary | Rule | Enforcement | Fallback |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Network | Loopback only; no auth | `settings.py` rejects non-loopback bind; `security.py` Host/Origin checks | Refuse to start or reject request |\n| Request origin | Same-origin state-changing requests | CSRF token, Origin/`Sec-Fetch-Site`, no wildcard CORS | 403 |\n| Secrets | Server-only | Config projection returns status; serializers allowlist; error redaction | Remove field / rotate credential |\n| Filesystem | Artifact ids only | Hash index; root allowlist; `safe_ticker_component` | 404/400 |\n| Uploads | Portfolio JSON text only | Size limit; parse; discard | 413/422 |\n| Execution | No trading route | Route inventory; security test | Remove endpoint |\n| History | Read-only | No mutating route; read model | Reject mutation |\n| Checkpoints | Clear is destructive | `{\"confirm\":\"CLEAR\"}`; disabled while running | 409 |\n| Rendering | Untrusted content is data | `rehype-sanitize`; no raw HTML; CSP; URL allowlist | Plain text |\n\n## 6. Destructive and privileged actions\n\n1. **Clear all checkpoints**: requires an explicit confirmation token, is disabled while a run is active, and reports only the count cleared.\n2. **Cancel analysis**: requires a same-origin state-changing request; no decision is written and no checkpoint is cleared.\n3. **Start a run**: may consume paid provider capacity; the UI must show provider/model and key status before submission.\n4. **Read decision memory**: read-only; no rotation or deletion from the web.\n5. **Download artifacts**: only through a resolved artifact id; filenames are sanitized; no path input.\n\n## 7. Coding-agent role boundary\n\nThe development roles remain defined by `.opencode/permissions.jsonc` and `AGENTS.md`. This document does not grant additional tool or path access.\n\n| Role | Product-code edits | Docs edits | Tests | Git/remote |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Plan | Denied | Denied | Read-only | Status only |\n| Build | Allowlisted `src/` and `test/`; protected paths require review | Only authorized records | May add tests after approval | Status/diff only |\n| Verify | Denied | Denied | Run only; no weakening | Status/diff only |\n| Docs | Denied | Allowlisted docs | Data validators only | Status/diff only |\n\nAn ACL `allow` is not plan approval. `permission-model.md` itself is a documentation artifact; it does not authorize implementation.\n\n## 8. Denials and fallback actions\n\n- A denied action returns a safe error category; it is not retried through a shell or another tool.\n- A missing key is a configuration state, not a permission bypass.\n- A rejected Host/Origin/CSRF request is logged with a reason but no payload.\n- A failed artifact resolution returns `not_found`; it never falls back to a broader root.\n- A failed sanitizer render falls back to plain text.\n\n## 9. Review and change control\n\n- Changes to this model require human review and a corresponding update to `docs/architecture/invariants.md`, `docs/architecture/runtime-policy-catalog.md`, and the relevant ADR.\n- Any proposal to add authentication, network exposure, new storage, execution, or browser key input is a scope change, not a configuration tweak.\n- No agent may edit `.opencode/rules.md` or `.opencode/permissions.jsonc` to widen its own access.\n"

              "path": "[LOCAL_USER_HOME]/Workspace/Projects/cityu/cs5351/TradingAgents/docs/architecture/memory-design.md",
              "content": "# TradingAgents WebUI Memory and State Design\n\nStatus: **Approved for documentation by the human owner on 2026-11-05.** This document records the approved state ownership. It does not authorize implementation.\n\n## 1. State inventory\n\n| State | Owner | Storage | Lifetime | Writers | Readers |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Active run record | `runtime/coordinator.py` (`RunCoordinator`) | Process memory | Until server exit or 5 min after terminal state | Coordinator | API, SSE |\n| Event sequence | `runtime/event_buffer.py` (`EventBuffer`) | Bounded process memory | Run + 5 min | Projector | SSE subscribers |\n| Graph instance | Worker thread | Python objects | Run | Worker | Coordinator |\n| Checkpoints | `TradingAgentsGraph` / `checkpointer` | Per-ticker SQLite | Existing persistence | Graph | Graph / CLI |\n| Decision log | `TradingMemoryLog` via graph | Markdown | Persistent | Graph only | History reader |\n| Run artifacts | `runtime/artifacts_writer.py` | Existing `results_dir` layout | Persistent | Worker | History reader |\n| History index cache | `artifacts/index.py` | Process memory | 5 s TTL | Scan | History API |\n| CLI preferences | `cli.prefs` | `~/.tradingagents/cli_prefs.json` | Persistent | CLI only | Config projection |\n| UI state | Zustand / TanStack Query | Browser memory | Tab lifetime | Frontend | Frontend |\n\nNo state is stored in a new database, message queue, or external cache.\n\n## 2. Existing decision memory\n\n`src/tradingagents/agents/utils/memory.py`:\n\n- Append-only Markdown, default `~/.tradingagents/memory/trading_memory.md`.\n- `store_decision()` appends a pending entry with `[date | ticker | rating | pending]`.\n- Settlement replaces the tag with raw return, alpha, holding window, and `resolved:<date>`, then appends a reflection.\n- Writes use a temp file plus `os.replace()`; this prevents torn files, not lost updates.\n- `get_past_context(..., as_of=...)` enforces the point-in-time filter.\n- `memory_log_max_entries` optionally prunes resolved entries; pending entries are never pruned.\n\nThe web layer writes through the graph's existing methods only. It never appends to the decision log directly.\n\n## 3. Existing checkpoints\n\n- Per-ticker SQLite under `<data_cache_dir>/checkpoints/<TICKER>.db`.\n- `thread_id(ticker, date, signature)` includes analyst selection, debate/risk rounds, asset type, and portfolio fingerprint.\n- Success clears the run's checkpoint; failure and cancellation leave it.\n- `clear_all_checkpoints()` removes `.db`, `-wal`, and `-shm`.\n\nThe web layer toggles `checkpoint_enabled`, reports resume/fresh from the run event, and exposes clear-all with confirmation. It does not compute checkpoint signatures independently.\n\n## 4. Existing CLI preferences\n\n- `~/.tradingagents/cli_prefs.json` contains stable last-run choices.\n- The web layer reads it for prefill only.\n- **Web runs do not write it.** Web UI preferences (language, theme, last wizard values) live in browser `localStorage`.\n- Unreadable preferences mean no defaults, never an error.\n\n## 5. In-memory run state\n\n`RunRecord` minimum fields:\n\n- `run_id`: server-generated, safe component.\n- Request: ticker, trade date, asset type, analysts, depth, provider, models, output language, checkpoint flag, portfolio fingerprint.\n- Lifecycle: `status`, `started_at`, `finished_at`, `last_seq`.\n- Result: signal, review flag, artifact ids, warnings, safe error category.\n- Worker: future, cancel event, thread identity (diagnostic only, not exposed).\n\n`EventBuffer`:\n\n- Monotonic `seq`, event type, timestamp, payload.\n- Bounded by count (10,000) and approximate bytes (8 MB), whichever is reached first.\n- Per-subscriber bounded queue (1,000 events); overflow drops the subscriber to snapshot mode.\n- Retained 5 minutes after terminal state for reattachment.\n\n## 6. Thread bridge\n\n- The graph stream is synchronous and may block on model calls.\n- The coordinator runs it in a single-worker `ThreadPoolExecutor`.\n- Events are published with `loop.call_soon_threadsafe(queue.put_nowait, event)`.\n- The cancellation flag is a `threading.Event`, checked between chunks.\n- `graph.end_checkpoint()` runs in the worker's `finally`.\n- The asyncio side never calls the synchronous stream directly.\n\n## 7. Artifact writing\n\n`runtime/artifacts_writer.py` mirrors the CLI's file layout without reimplementing business logic:\n\n- `results_dir/<ticker>/<date>/message_tool.log`: `HH:MM:SS [Type] content` and `HH:MM:SS [Tool Call] name(args)`.\n- `results_dir/<ticker>/<date>/reports/<section>.md`: section key filenames, matching the CLI.\n- On success: `write_report_tree(final_state, ticker, results_dir/reports/<ticker>_<timestamp>/)`.\n- On cancel/failure: keep the partial message log and section files; no complete report is synthesized.\n- No `full_states_log_*.json` is written by the web stream path.\n\n## 8. Concurrency and write ownership\n\nOne process, one active run, one worker. This protects:\n\n- the process-global configuration in `src/tradingagents/dataflows/config.py`;\n- the read-modify-write decision log;\n- checkpoint databases;\n- the event buffer and artifact writer.\n\nA second submission is rejected with `409`. There is no queue. Concurrent runs would require per-run configuration isolation, a serialized or owned decision-log writer, per-run artifact namespaces, and a lost-update test; that is outside this design.\n\n## 9. Cancellation and failure\n\n| Event | Decision log | Checkpoint | Artifacts | Run state |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Cancel analysis | not written | preserved | partial kept | `cancelled` |\n| Worker failure | not written | preserved | partial kept | `failed` |\n| Report save failure | written (analysis completed) | cleared as normal | sections + message log; report tree may be absent | `completed` + warning |\n| Browser disconnect | unchanged | unchanged | unchanged | continues |\n| Server restart | unchanged | unchanged | unchanged | active run lost |\n\nA retry is a new run with a new request. The web layer never infers an outcome from a failed run.\n\n## 10. Point-in-time and retention\n\n- Analysis-date validation remains in the core.\n- `as_of` past-lesson filtering remains in `create_run_state`.\n- Backtests keep their own log and date grid.\n- History reads stored artifacts and does not reconstruct unrecorded outcomes.\n- Decision-memory rotation remains the existing configuration; the web exposes no deletion or rotation.\n- Checkpoint clear is the only destructive web control.\n\n## 11. Recovery boundaries\n\n- Browser disconnect does not affect memory or checkpoints.\n- Server restart loses the in-memory run record and event buffer.\n- Decision log, run artifacts, and checkpoints remain on disk.\n- The CLI/API can resume a checkpointed run; the web does not claim cross-process recovery.\n"

              "content": "# TradingAgents WebUI Runtime Policy Catalog\n\nStatus: **Approved for documentation by the human owner on 2026-11-05.** These policies describe required runtime behaviour. No policy below is implemented. Each names an enforcement module and a fallback.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-001 — Loopback-only listener\n\nTrigger: server start.\nRule: bind `127.0.0.1` only; reject non-loopback `Host`; no wildcard CORS.\nEnforcement: `settings.py`, `security.py`.\nFallback: refuse to start on a non-loopback address.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-002 — Single active run\n\nTrigger: a new analysis or backtest request.\nRule: if a run is `starting`, `running`, or `cancelling`, return `409` with the active run id. No queue.\nEnforcement: `runtime/coordinator.py`.\nFallback: return the active run id so the client can reattach.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-003 — Process-lifetime run state\n\nTrigger: browser disconnect, refresh, or network loss.\nRule: continue the run; allow reattachment from the last sequence within the process lifetime. A restart loses the run.\nEnforcement: `runtime/coordinator.py`, `runtime/event_buffer.py`.\nFallback: show \"run no longer available\"; on-disk artifacts and checkpoints remain.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-004 — Analysis cancellation\n\nTrigger: a same-origin cancel request for the active analysis.\nRule: set the cancel event; stop at the next chunk; do not call `record_decision`; do not call `clear_checkpoint_on_success`; `end_checkpoint()` in `finally`; keep partial artifacts; publish `run.cancelled`.\nEnforcement: `runtime/coordinator.py`.\nFallback: if the worker does not stop in 30 s, report `cancelling` and keep the slot until it exits.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-005 — Checkpoint controls\n\nTrigger: checkpoint toggle or clear-all.\nRule: the toggle affects the next run only. Clear-all requires `{\"confirm\": \"CLEAR\"}` and is rejected while a run is active. Clear-all calls `clear_all_checkpoints`.\nEnforcement: `api/runs.py`, `runtime/coordinator.py`.\nFallback: reject the clear, report the count cleared, never expose a path.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-006 — Server-only provider keys\n\nTrigger: configuration display or run start.\nRule: read keys only from the server environment; return `configured / not_configured / not_required`; never accept, store, return, log, or export a key. A missing key does not block start; the first provider call fails safely.\nEnforcement: `api/config.py`, `models/responses.py`, `errors.py`.\nFallback: show a safe configuration error; keep the run record.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-007 — Deterministic identifiers\n\nTrigger: any ticker, run id, artifact id, or path component from a client.\nRule: validate with existing rules before filesystem use; reject absolute paths, `..`, backslashes, and values outside the allowlist.\nEnforcement: `api/runs.py`, `artifacts/index.py`.\nFallback: reject; never widen the path.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-008 — Artifact ids, not paths\n\nTrigger: any response referencing an artifact.\nRule: return `sha256(relative_path)[:16]`; resolve server-side through a 5 s in-memory map; omit path fields.\nEnforcement: `artifacts/index.py`, `models/responses.py`.\nFallback: omit the artifact and return a safe not-found.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-009 — Read-only history\n\nTrigger: history or backtest-history request.\nRule: read only; no delete, rename, move, rotation, migration, or index write.\nEnforcement: `artifacts/index.py`, `artifacts/readers.py`, `api/history.py`.\nFallback: reject any mutating request.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-010 — Backtest isolation\n\nTrigger: backtest request.\nRule: use the backtest's own run directory and memory log; never read or write the live decision log. A backtest occupies the single-run slot.\nEnforcement: `runtime/backtest_runner.py`.\nFallback: abort and report the isolation failure.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-011 — Announcement handling\n\nTrigger: page load or refresh.\nRule: fetch server-side; on failure use the CLI fallback; `require_attention=true` blocks until acknowledged; render as untrusted text.\nEnforcement: `api/announcements.py`, `frontend/src/components/Announcements`.\nFallback: show the fallback link and do not block.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-012 — Untrusted rendering\n\nTrigger: model output, tool output, announcements, artifact text, portfolio text.\nRule: escaped text or sanitized Markdown; no raw HTML; no script; no `javascript:`/`data:` links; no server-side template evaluation.\nEnforcement: `frontend/src/components/Markdown.tsx`, `security.py`.\nFallback: plain text.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-013 — Error redaction\n\nTrigger: any validation, upstream, storage, or internal error.\nRule: return category, safe message, correlation id; redact keys, tokens, cookies, authorization headers, paths, and stack traces.\nEnforcement: `errors.py`, `security.py`.\nFallback: generic internal error with a correlation id.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-014 — Bounded event buffer\n\nTrigger: event publication or subscription.\nRule: bounded buffer (10,000 events or 8 MB), bounded subscriber queue (1,000), snapshot fallback, heartbeat every 15 s.\nEnforcement: `runtime/event_buffer.py`.\nFallback: drop the subscriber to snapshot mode; keep the run alive.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-015 — No execution authority\n\nTrigger: any rating, report, or model output.\nRule: display only; no order/position endpoint; no brokerage dependency.\nEnforcement: route inventory, `api/`.\nFallback: remove the endpoint or control.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-016 — Honest run state\n\nTrigger: completion, failure, cancellation.\nRule: derive state from actual stream completion and artifact writes; show partial artifacts as partial; do not report an unreadable rating as a position.\nEnforcement: `runtime/coordinator.py`, `frontend/src/pages/Report`.\nFallback: show failed/review and preserve raw decision text.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-017 — Backtest has no cancel control\n\nTrigger: a backtest is running.\nRule: do not expose a cancel route or button. State that the backtest runs to completion and can be resumed with `run_id`.\nEnforcement: `api/backtests.py`, `frontend/src/pages/Backtest`.\nFallback: remove any misleading control.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-018 — Same-origin state-changing requests\n\nTrigger: POST/DELETE from the browser.\nRule: require the per-process `X-CSRF-Token`; if `Origin` is present it must match the loopback origin; reject cross-origin; no wildcard CORS.\nEnforcement: `security.py`.\nFallback: 403 with a safe message.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-019 — Static asset presence\n\nTrigger: server start.\nRule: if `static/index.html` is missing, start in API-only mode with a clear build instruction; never serve a broken UI silently.\nEnforcement: `app.py`, `cli.py`.\nFallback: API-only mode; CI packaging test fails.\n\n## WEB-POLICY-020 — Run artifact writing\n\nTrigger: analysis run.\nRule: write `message_tool.log` and `reports/<section>.md` in the CLI layout; auto-save the complete tree on success; keep partial artifacts on cancel/failure; do not write `full_states_log`.\nEnforcement: `runtime/artifacts_writer.py`.\nFallback: emit `storage` warning; keep the analysis result and partial artifacts.\n"

              "content": "# TradingAgents WebUI Option Ledger\n\nStatus: **Approved for documentation by the human owner on 2026-11-05.** \"Approved\" means the decision is accepted for documentation. It does not authorize implementation or dependency installation. \"Rejected\" records a reason, not a permanent prohibition.\n\n| ID | Decision area | Option | Status | Rationale |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| OL-001 | Deployment | Local loopback, single user, no authentication | Approved | Confirmed minimum assumption; smallest security and operational surface. |\n| OL-002 | Deployment | LAN access with a shared password | Deferred | Requires session and credential handling not confirmed by the user. |\n| OL-003 | Deployment | Public multi-user with accounts | Out of scope | Requires auth, tenancy, quotas, and audit. |\n| OL-004 | Run concurrency | One active run per process | Approved | Matches the global configuration and non-concurrent memory writer. |\n| OL-005 | Run concurrency | Serial queue | Deferred | Adds a scheduler without a confirmed need. |\n| OL-006 | Run concurrency | Parallel runs | Rejected for this iteration | Requires core configuration isolation and memory write ownership. |\n| OL-007 | Run state | In-memory run record and bounded event buffer | Approved | Satisfies process-lifetime reattachment without new storage. |\n| OL-008 | Run state | File-backed run journal | Deferred | Adds a persistence format and cleanup policy. |\n| OL-009 | Run state | Database or message queue | Rejected | Explicitly excluded; second source of truth and new dependency. |\n| OL-010 | History | Read-only projection over existing artifacts | Approved | Confirmed; no new index or retention policy. |\n| OL-011 | History | New index database | Rejected | Duplicates artifact state and requires storage approval. |\n| OL-012 | History | Current-session-only history | Rejected | Confirmed history must read existing artifacts. |\n| OL-013 | Provider keys | Server environment only | Approved | Avoids transmitting plaintext keys to the browser. |\n| OL-014 | Provider keys | Browser input kept in process memory | Rejected | Still transmits plaintext credentials into a client surface. |\n| OL-015 | Provider keys | Browser input written to `.env` | Rejected | Highest risk; lets a web request mutate credentials on disk. |\n| OL-016 | Analysis cancellation | Stop, no decision entry, no checkpoint clear, keep partial artifacts | Approved | Matches CLI `Ctrl-C` semantics. |\n| OL-017 | Analysis cancellation | Stop and delete partial artifacts | Rejected | Destroys useful partial reports and diverges from the CLI. |\n| OL-018 | Analysis cancellation | Stop client updates only, let the run continue | Rejected | Makes \"cancel\" misleading. |\n| OL-019 | Package location | `src/tradingagents_web/` | Approved | Included by the existing `tradingagents*` pattern; keeps presentation out of the core tree. |\n| OL-020 | Package location | `src/tradingagents/web/` | Rejected | The structural check forbids presentation framework imports under the core. |\n| OL-021 | Package location | `src/webui/` | Rejected for this iteration | Requires a packaging include change and governance approval. |\n| OL-022 | Backend framework | FastAPI + Uvicorn | Approved | Pydantic validation, OpenAPI, async, SSE, and single-worker lifecycle fit the existing Python stack. |\n| OL-023 | Backend framework | Starlette only | Rejected | Manual validation and error models add code without a confirmed benefit. |\n| OL-024 | Backend framework | Flask/WSGI | Rejected | Synchronous model and weaker streaming ergonomics. |\n| OL-025 | Backend framework | Django | Rejected | Too heavy for a local single-user presentation layer. |\n| OL-026 | Event transport | SSE | Approved | One-way server-to-client; `EventSource` reconnection; simpler than WebSocket. |\n| OL-027 | Event transport | WebSocket | Rejected | Bidirectional framing/lifecycle with no confirmed need. |\n| OL-028 | Event transport | Long polling | Rejected | Higher request overhead and less immediate updates. |\n| OL-029 | Frontend framework | React 19 + TypeScript + Vite | Approved | Explicit user selection; SPA is sufficient; no SSR/Node server. |\n| OL-030 | Frontend framework | Server-rendered templates + minimal JS | Rejected | Weaker for the live event view and report navigation. |\n| OL-031 | UI technology | Tailwind + shadcn/ui (Radix) + Lucide | Approved | Accessible primitives, controllable styling, no heavy design-system lock-in. |\n| OL-032 | UI technology | MUI / Ant Design | Rejected | Comprehensive but heavy and opinionated for this local tool. |\n| OL-033 | Client state | Zustand + TanStack Query | Approved | Zustand for one active run; Query for config/history/backtests. |\n| OL-034 | Client state | Redux Toolkit | Rejected | More ceremony than needed for one active run. |\n| OL-035 | Forms | React Hook Form + Zod | Approved | Step-level validation with a clear schema; backend remains authoritative. |\n| OL-036 | Markdown | react-markdown + remark-gfm + rehype-sanitize | Approved | Untrusted content requires a sanitizer and no raw HTML. |\n| OL-037 | i18n | react-i18next, English default, Chinese switch | Approved | Two-language catalogue with key-completeness testing; report language stays separate. |\n| OL-038 | Testing | pytest + Vitest/RTL/MSW + Playwright | Approved | Backend contract/security, component behavior, real-browser flows. |\n| OL-039 | Authentication | None, loopback-only | Approved | Compensated by Host/Origin/CSRF/CSP. |\n| OL-040 | Authentication | Reverse-proxy authentication | Deferred | No confirmed proxy or identity provider. |\n| OL-041 | Downloads | Complete Markdown + zip of existing artifacts | Approved | Matches existing artifacts;               "content": "\"\"\"Web settings with safe defaults for a loopback-only single-user server.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nPACKAGE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent\nDEFAULT_STATIC_DIR = PACKAGE_DIR / \"static\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass WebSettings:\n    \"\"\"Runtime settings for the read-only WebUI.\n\n    ``host`` is deliberately restricted to loopback values. The approved\n    deployment has no authentication, so binding anywhere else is a security\n    error, not a configuration preference.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    results_dir: Path\n    memory_log_path: Path\n    data_cache_dir: Path\n    host: str = \"127.0.0.1\"\n    static_dir: Path = DEFAULT_STATIC_DIR\n    max_report_bytes: int = 5_000_000\n    max_zip_bytes: int = 20_000_000\n    history_page_size: int = 50\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        object.__setattr__(self, \"results_dir\", Path(self.results_dir))\n        object.__setattr__(self, \"memory_log_path\", Path(self.memory_log_path))\n        object.__setattr__(self, \"data_cache_dir\", Path(self.data_cache_dir))\n        object.__setattr__(self, \"static_dir\", Path(self.static_dir))\n        if self.host not in {\"127.0.0.1\", \"localhost\"}:\n            raise ValueError(\n                \"WebUI may bind only to 127.0.0.1 or localhost; \"\n                f\"got {self.host!r}\"\n            )\n        if self.max_report_bytes <= 0:\n            raise ValueError(\"max_report_bytes must be positive\")\n        if self.max_zip_bytes <= 0:\n            raise ValueError(\"max_zip_bytes must be positive\")\n        if self.history_page_size <= 0:\n            raise ValueError(\"history_page_size must be positive\")\n"

              "content": "\"\"\"Security helpers: Host validation, CSP headers, and secret redaction.\n\nThe WebUI is loopback-only and has no authentication. Host/origin checks and a\nstrict CSP are the compensating controls. Artifact text is redacted for exact\nvalues of credential-like environment variables before it is returned.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nfrom typing import Any\n\nCSP = (\n    \"default-src 'self'; \"\n    \"script-src 'self'; \"\n    \"style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; \"\n    \"img-src 'self' data:; \"\n    \"font-src 'self'; \"\n    \"connect-src 'self'; \"\n    \"frame-ancestors 'none'; \"\n    \"base-uri 'none'; \"\n    \"form-action 'self'\"\n)\n\n_SECRET_ENV_RE = re.compile(r\"(API_KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|CREDENTIAL)$\", re.I)\n_MIN_REDACT_LEN = 12\n\n\ndef host_allowed(host_header: str | None) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Allow only loopback Host headers, with or without a port.\"\"\"\n    if not host_header:\n        return False\n    host = host_header.strip()\n    if host.startswith(\"[\"):\n        # IPv6 form: [::1]:8000\n        host = host.split(\"]\", 1)[0].removeprefix(\"[\")\n    elif \":\" in host:\n        host = host.rsplit(\":\", 1)[0]\n    return host.lower() in {\"127.0.0.1\", \"localhost\"}\n\n\ndef security_headers() -> dict[str, str]:\n    return {\n        \"Content-Security-Policy\": CSP,\n        \"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\",\n        \"Referrer-Policy\": \"no-referrer\",\n        \"Permissions-Policy\": \"camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()\",\n        \"X-Frame-Options\": \"DENY\",\n    }\n\n\ndef collect_secrets(environ: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[str, ...]:\n    \"\"\"Collect exact credential-like values for response redaction.\n\n    Short values are ignored to avoid redacting ordinary words. This is a\n    best-effort boundary, not a substitute for not putting secrets in artifacts.\n    \"\"\"\n    source = environ if environ is not None else os.environ\n    secrets = {\n        value\n        for name, value in source.items()\n        if value\n        and len(value) >= _MIN_REDACT_LEN\n        and _SECRET_ENV_RE.search(name)\n    }\n    return tuple(sorted(secrets, key=len, reverse=True))\n\n\ndef redact_text(text: str, secrets: tuple[str, ...] | None = None) -> str:\n    if not text:\n        return text\n    for secret in secrets if secrets is not None else collect_secrets():\n        if secret and secret in text:\n            text = text.replace(secret, \"***\")\n    return text\n\n\ndef redact_obj(value: Any, secrets: tuple[str, ...] | None = None) -> Any:\n    \"\"\"Recursively redact strings in JSON-compatible data.\"\"\"\n    if isinstance(value, str):\n        return redact_text(value, secrets)\n    if isinstance(value, dict):\n        return {key: redact_obj(child, secrets) for key, child in value.items()}\n    if isinstance(value, list):\n        return [redact_obj(child, secrets) for child in value]\n    if isinstance(value, tuple):\n        return [redact_obj(child, secrets) for child in value]\n    return value\n"
            },

              "content": "\"\"\"Safe error payloads for the WebUI.\n\nErrors never include stack traces, absolute paths, or credential values.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport uuid\n\nfrom fastapi.responses import JSONResponse\n\n\ndef error_payload(category: str, message: str, **fields) -> dict:\n    payload = {\n        \"error\": {\n            \"category\": category,\n            \"message\": message,\n            \"correlation_id\": f\"c_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}\",\n        }\n    }\n    if fields:\n        payload[\"error\"][\"fields\"] = fields\n    return payload\n\n\ndef error_response(status_code: int, category: str, message: str, **fields) -> JSONResponse:\n    return JSONResponse(\n        status_code=status_code,\n        content=error_payload(category, message, **fields),\n    )\n"

              "content": "import { Languages } from \"lucide-react\";\nimport { useTranslation } from \"react-i18next\";\n\nexport function LanguageSwitch() {\n  const { i18n, t } = useTranslation();\n  const next = i18n.language.startsWith(\"zh\") ? \"en\" : \"zh\";\n\n  function toggle() {\n    void i18n.changeLanguage(next);\n    window.localStorage.setItem(\"ta.language\", next);\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <button\n      type=\"button\"\n      onClick={toggle}\n      className=\"inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-slate-700 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-800\"\n      aria-label={t(\"nav.language\")}\n    >\n      <Languages size={16} />\n      {next === \"zh\" ? \"中文\" : \"EN\"}\n    </button>\n  );\n}\n"

              "content": "export type HistorySource = \"run\" | \"saved\" | \"backtest\" | \"decision\";\n\nexport type HistoryItem = {\n  artifact_id: string;\n  source: HistorySource;\n  ticker: string;\n  date: string | null;\n  status: string;\n  rating: string | null;\n  review: boolean;\n  updated_at: string;\n  title: string;\n};\n\nexport type HistoryResponse = {\n  items: HistoryItem[];\n  next_cursor: string | null;\n};\n\nexport type ArtifactRef = { kind: string; section?: string };\n\nexport type HistoryDetail = {\n  artifact_id: string;\n  source: HistorySource;\n  ticker: string;\n  date: string | null;\n  status: string;\n  rating: string | null;\n  review: boolean;\n  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;\n  sections?: Record<string, string>;\n  artifacts?: ArtifactRef[];\n  summary?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  entries?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n};\n\nasync function requestJson<T>(url: string): Promise<T> {\n  const response = await fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: \"application/json\" } });\n  if (!response.ok) {\n    throw new Error(`Request failed with status ${response.status}`);\n  }\n  return (await response.json()) as T;\n}\n\nexport function getHistory(params: { limit?: number; cursor?: string | null } = {}) {\n  const search = new URLSearchParams();\n  search.set(\"limit\", String(params.limit ?? 50));\n  if (params.cursor) search.set(\"cursor\", params.cursor);\n  return requestJson<HistoryResponse>(`/api/history?${search.toString()}`);\n}\n\nexport function getHistoryDetail(artifactId: string) {\n  return requestJson<HistoryDetail>(\n    `/api/history/${encodeURIComponent(artifactId)}`,\n  );\n}\n\nexport function downloadUrl(\n  artifactId: string,\n  kind: \"complete\" | \"archive\" | \"section\",\n  section?: string,\n) {\n  const search = new URLSearchParams({ kind });\n  if (section) search.set(\"section\", section);\n  return `/api/history/${encodeURIComponent(artifactId)}/download?${search.toString()}`;\n}\n"
            },

(\n        <div className=\"overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-slate-800\">\n          <table className=\"w-full text-left text-sm\">\n            <thead className=\"bg-slate-900 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-400\">\n              <tr>\n                <th className=\"px-4 py-3\">{t(\"history.ticker\")}</th>\n                <th className=\"px-4 py-3\">{t(\"history.date\")}</th>\n                <th className=\"px-4 py-3\">{t(\"history.source\")}</th>\n                <th className=\"px-4 py-3\">{t(\"history.status\")}</th>\n                <th className=\"px-4 py-3\">{t(\"history.rating\")}</th>\n                <th className=\"px-4 py-3\">{t(\"history.actions\")}</th>\n              </tr>\n            </thead>\n            <tbody className=\"divide-y divide-slate-800\">\n              {history.data.items.map((item) => (\n                <tr key={item.artifact_id} className=\"hover:bg-slate-900/60\">\n                  <td className=\"px-4 py-3 font-mono text-slate-200\">{item.ticker}</td>\n                  <td className=\"px-4 py-3 text-slate-400\">{item.date ?? Object.entries(detail.data.sections).map(([section, content]) => (\n                <article key={section} className=\"rounded-lg border border-slate-800 p-5\">\n                  <h2 className=\"mb-3 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-cyan-300\">\n                    {section}\n                  </h2>\n                  <Markdown>{content}</Markdown>\n                </article>\n              ))\n            : null}\n\n          {detail.data.summary ? Path | 用途 |\n|---|---|---|\n| GET | `/api/session` | CSRF token、服务器时间 |\n| GET | `/api/config` | 默认值、provider、env 锁、key 状态、prefs |\n| GET | `/api/config/models?provider=&mode=` | 模型列表；OpenRouter 服务端拉取 |\n| POST | `/api/portfolio/validate` | 校验粘贴/上传 JSON；不落盘 |\n| POST | `/api/checkpoints/clear` | `{\"confirm\":\"CLEAR\"}`；运行中 409 |\n| POST | `/api/runs` | 发起分析；单运行；幂等 request id |\n| GET | `/api/runs/active` | 当前活动 run 快照 |\n| GET | `/api/runs/{run_id}` | 快照 |\n| GET | `/api/runs/{run_id}/events?after_seq=` | SSE |\n| POST | `/api/runs/{run_id}/cancel` | 分析取消 |\n\n**SSE 事件：** `run.preparing`、`run.started`、`run.resumed`、`agent.status`、`message`、`tool_call`、`report.section`、`stats`、`run.completed`、`run.failed`、`run.cancelled`、`snapshot`、heartbeat。\n\n**运行状态：** `idle → starting → running → completed | failed | cancelled`；`cancelling` 为取消等待态。\n\n**取消：** 停止消费、不写决策、不清 Checkpoint、`finally end_checkpoint()`、保留部分产物；30 秒未停止则返回 `cancelling`，槽位仍占用。\n\n**重连：** snapshot + `after_seq`；缓冲 10,000 事件/8 MB；慢客户端降级 snapshot；进程重启丢失活动 run。\n\n## 6. 状态所有权与失败处理\n\n| 状态 | 所有者 | 存储 | 生命周期 |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 活动 run | `RunCoordinator` | 进程内存 | 运行 + 5 分钟 |\n| 事件序列 | `EventBuffer` | 有界内存 | 运行 + 5 分钟 |\n| Graph/Checkpoint | 核心 | 内存/SQLite | 运行/既有持久化 |\n| 决策日志 | 核心 | Markdown | 持久化 |\n| 运行 artifacts | `RunArtifactWriter` | 现有 `results_dir` | 持久化 |\n| 历史索引 | Iteration-1 | 内存 5s 缓存 | 请求周期 |\n\n失败处理：\n\n- 上游模型/数据失败 → `run.failed`，不写决策、不清 Checkpoint、保留部分产物。\n- 取消 → `run.cancelled`，同上。\n- 报告保存失败 → `run.completed` + warning；分析结果仍可用。\n- SSE 缓冲溢出 → snapshot。\n- 进程重启 → 活动 run 丢失；磁盘 artifacts/Checkpoint 保留。\n- 无执行/下单路由。\n\n## 7. 依赖变更\n\n**本轮无新增 Python 运行时依赖**（FastAPI/Uvicorn/httpx 已在 Iteration-1 加入）。  \n**本轮无前端依赖变更**（2B 才需要 RHF/Zod/更多 Radix 组件）。\n\n因此 2A 不修改 `pyproject.toml`           "text": "# Iteration-2 合并计划（Plan v2，2026-11-06）\n\n已按你的要求将 2A（后端运行控制面）与 2B（向导/实时 UI）合并为一个 **Iteration-2**。当前 `feature/webui` 工作区干净，Iteration-1 提交为 `5b012aa`，未 push。\n\n> 本消息仅为计划与测试方案，不修改文件、不写测试、不实现代码。等待你明确批准后，先写 test-only revision，再实现。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 迭代目标\n\n> 在 WebUI 中完成一次分析运行的完整闭环：**8 步向导 → 单运行启动 → SSE 实时进度/消息/工具/报告 → 取消 → 断线重连 → 完成报告 → 历史可见/下载**。\n\n**范围边界：**\n\n- 只支持**一个活动分析运行**，不做队列、并发、跨进程恢复。\n- 不支持回测发起、公告面板、多用户、认证、交易执行。\n- 不修改 `src/tradingagents/` 与 `src/cli/`。\n- 不引入数据库/消息队列。\n\n**延后到 Iteration-3：** 回测发起与结果页、公告面板、回测隔离验证。\n\n---\n\n## 2. 需求与验收标准\n\n### 本轮完整覆盖\n\n| 需求 | 验收标准 |\n|---|---|\n| `REQ-WEB-001` 八步向导 | `FC-WEB-001-01/02/03/04` |\n| `REQ-WEB-002` 实时视图 | `FC-WEB-002-01/02/03/04` |\n| `REQ-WEB-003` Checkpoint 控制 | `FC-WEB-003-01/02/03` |\n| `REQ-WEB-004` Portfolio | `FC-WEB-004-01/02/03` |\n| `REQ-WEB-005` 取消分析 | `FC-WEB-005-01/02/03/04` |\n| `REQ-WEB-006` 单运行 | `FC-WEB-006-01/02` |\n| `REQ-WEB-007` 断线重连 | `FC-WEB-007-01/02/03` |\n| `REQ-WEB-008` 报告/摘要 | `FC-WEB-008-01/02/03` |\n| `REQ-WEB-009` 落盘/下载 | `FC-WEB-009-01/02/03` |\n| `REQ-WEB-013` 密钥处理 | `FC-WEB-013-01/02/03` |\n| `REQ-WEB-014` 中英 UI | `FC-WEB-014-01/02/03`（新增文案纳入 key 对齐） |\n| `REQ-WEB-020` loopback/无登录 | `FC-WEB-020-01/02/03`（新增 CSRF 补偿控制） |\n| `REQ-WEB-021` 浏览器矩阵 | `FC-WEB-021-01`（Playwright 三引擎执行） |\n| `REQ-WEB-022` 事件延迟 | `FC-WEB-022-01/02` |\n| `REQ-WEB-023` 密钥不泄漏 | `FC-WEB-023-01/02` |\n| `REQ-WEB-024` 无服务器路径 | `FC-WEB-024-01/02` |\n| `REQ-WEB-025` 不可信内容 | `FC-WEB-025-01/02`（运行时 XSS 测试） |\n| `REQ-WEB-026` 核心/CLI 不变 | `FC-WEB-026-01/02` |\n| `REQ-WEB-027` 不扩能力 | `FC-WEB-027-01/02/03` |\n| `REQ-WEB-028` Portfolio/REVIEW | `FC-WEB-028-01/02` |\n| `REQ-WEB-029` 运行状态安全 | `FC-WEB-029-01/02` |\n| `REQ-WEB-031` 输出仅建议 | `FC-WEB-031-01/02` |\n\n### 明确不在本轮\n\n- `REQ-WEB-011` 回测发起\n- `REQ-WEB-012` 公告\n- `REQ-WEB-030` 回测隔离\n- 多用户/认证/交易执行/新数据源/新模型\n- 跨进程运行恢复\n\n---\n\n## 3. CSRF；与 Host/Origin/CSP 共同构成补偿控制。\n- **ADR-010：Wizard and Live-Run UI State**\n  - React Hook Form + Zod、Zustand run store、TanStack Query、i18n、错误/重连 UI。\n\n### 直接验证的不变量\n\n`INV-WEB-002/003/004/005/006/007/009/010/012/013/014/015`；历史只读 `INV-WEB-011` 作为回归。\n\n---\n\n## 4. 后端设计\n\n### 新增/扩展模块\n\n```text\nsrc/tradingagents_web/\n├── api/\n│   ├── session.py        # GET /api/session，CSRF token\n│   ├── config.py         # GET /api/config, /api/config/models\n│   ├── portfolio.py      # POST /api/portfolio/validate\n│   ├── checkpoints.py    # POST /api/checkpoints/clear\n│   └── runs.py           # POST/GET/cancel/SSE\n├── runtime/\n│   ├── coordinator.py    # 单运行、状态机、worker 线程\n│   ├── graph_runner.py   # 调用现有 TradingAgentsGraph\n│   ├── projector.py      # stream chunk -> events\n│   ├── event_buffer.py   # 有界缓冲、订阅者、snapshot\n│   └── artifacts_writer.py\n├── models/\n│   ├── requests.py\n│   ├── responses.py\n│   └── events.py\n├── security.py           # 扩展 CSRF\n├── settings.py           # 事件/请求/运行上限\n└── app.py                # 注册 routers、CSRF middleware\n```\n\n### API 契约\n\n| Method | Path | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| GET | `/api/session` | CSRF token、服务器时间 |\n| GET | `/api/config` | 默认值、provider、env 锁、key 状态、prefs |\n| GET | `/api/config/models?provider=&mode=` | 模型列表；OpenRouter 服务端拉取/缓存 |\n| POST | `/api/portfolio/validate` | 粘贴/上传 JSON；不落盘 |\n| POST | `/api/checkpoints/clear` | `{\"confirm\":\"CLEAR\"}`；运行中 409 |\n| POST | `/api/runs` | 发起分析；单运行；`client_request_id` 幂等 |\n| GET | `/api/runs/active` | 当前活动 run 快照 |\n| GET | `/api/runs/{run_id}` | 快照 |\n| GET | `/api/runs/{run_id}/events?after_seq=` | SSE |\n| POST | `/api/runs/{run_id}/cancel` | 取消分析 |\n\n### 运行状态与事件\n\n- 状态：`idle → starting → running → completed | failed | cancelled`；取消等待为 `cancelling`。\n- 事件：`run.preparing`、`run.started`、`run.resumed`、`agent.status`、`message`、`tool_call`、`report.section`、`stats`、`run.completed`、`run.failed`、`run.cancelled`、`snapshot`、heartbeat。\n- SSE：`id=seq`、`event=type`、`data=payload`；15s heartbeat；`after_seq`/`Last-Event-ID`；10,000 事件或 8 MB 上限；慢客户端降级 snapshot。\n- 取消：停止消费；不写决策；不清 Checkpoint；`finally end_checkpoint()`；保留部分产物；30s 未停止返回 `cancelling`。\n- 完成：合并 values 流；`process_signal`；`write_report_tree` 自动保存到 `results_dir/reports/<ticker>_<timestamp>/`；history 可发现。\n- 不写 `full_states_log`；沿用 CLI stream 路径。\n\n---\n\n## 5. 前端设计\n\n### 新增页面/组件\n\n```text\nfrontend/src/\n├── pages/\n│   ├── NewAnalysisPage.tsx    # 8 步向导\n│   ├── LiveRunPage.tsx        # 实时进度/消息/工具/报告/统计\n│   └── RunReportPage.tsx      # 完成报告（复用 History snapshot/after_seq\n└── api/runClient.ts\n```\n\n### 行为\n\n- 向导：8 步 + Review；本地 Zod 校验；后端权威校验；env 锁定字段只读；Key 状态只读；缺 Key 允许提交。\n- 实时页：Progress、Messages & Tools、Current Report               "content": "import { describe, expect, it } from \"vitest\";\n\nimport en from \"../src/i18n/en.json\";\nimport zh from \"../src/i18n/zh.json\";\n\nfunction flatten(value: unknown, prefix = \"\"): string[] {\n  if (value && typeof value === \"object\" && !Array.isArray(value)) {\n    return Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>).flatMap(([key, child]) =>\n      flatten(child, prefix ? `${prefix}.${key}` : key),\n    );\n  }\n  return [prefix];\n}\n\ndescribe(\"i18n catalogues\", () => {\n  it(\"have identical keys\", () => {\n    expect(new Set(flatten(zh))).toEqual(new Set(flatten(en)));\n  });\n\n  it(\"are not empty\", () => {\n    expect(flatten(en).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n  });\n});\n"
            },

              "content": "\"\"\"Run request schema. Unknown fields are rejected on purpose.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Literal\n\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field\n\n\nclass RunRequest(BaseModel):\n    model_config = ConfigDict(extra=\"forbid\")\n\n    client_request_id: str = Field(min_length=1)\n    ticker: str = Field(min_length=1)\n    trade_date: str = Field(min_length=10, max_length=10)\n    asset_type: Literal[\"stock\", \"crypto\"] = \"stock\"\n    output_language: str = \"English\"\n    analysts: list[str] = Field(\n        default_factory=lambda: [\"market\", \"social\", \"news\", \"fundamentals\"]\n    )\n    research_depth: int = 1\n    llm_provider: str = \"openai\"\n    backend_url: str | None = None\n    quick_think_llm: str\n    deep_think_llm: str\n    google_thinking_level: str | None = None\n    openai_reasoning_effort: str | None = None\n    anthropic_effort: str | None = None\n    checkpoint: bool = False\n    portfolio_json: str | None = None\n\n\nclass PortfolioValidationRequest(BaseModel):\n    model_config = ConfigDict(extra=\"forbid\")\n\n    json: str\n\n\nclass CheckpointClearRequest(BaseModel):\n    model_config = ConfigDict(extra=\"forbid\")\n\n    confirm: str\n"

              "content": "\"\"\"Bounded, thread-safe event sequence with replay support.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport threading\nfrom collections import deque\n\n\nclass EventBuffer:\n    def __init__(self, max_events: int = 10_000):\n        self._events: deque[dict] = deque(maxlen=max_events)\n        self._lock = threading.Lock()\n        self._seq = 0\n\n    @property\n    def last_seq(self) -> int:\n        with self._lock:\n            return self._seq\n\n    def append(self, event: dict) -> dict:\n        with self._lock:\n            self._seq += 1\n            stored = {**event, \"seq\": self._seq}\n            self._events.append(stored)\n            return stored\n\n    def since(self, seq: int) -> list[dict]:\n        with self._lock:\n            return [event for event in self._events if event[\"seq\"] > seq]\n\n    def first_seq(self) -> int | None:\n        with self._lock:\n            return self._events[0][\"seq\"] if self._events else None\n"

              "content": "export type WizardStep =\n  | \"ticker\"\n  | \"date\"\n  | \"language\"\n  | \"analysts\"\n  | \"depth\"\n  | \"provider\"\n  | \"models\"\n  | \"portfolio\"\n  | \"review\";\n\nexport type ValidationResult = { ok: boolean; error?: string };\n\nconst TICKER_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9._\\-^=]+$/;\n\nexport function validateStep(\n  step: WizardStep,\n  values: Record<string, unknown>,\n): ValidationResult {\n  if (step === \"ticker\") {\n    const ticker = String(values.ticker ?? \"\").trim();\n    if (!ticker) return { ok: false, error: \"Ticker is required.\" };\n    if (ticker.length > 32 || !TICKER_RE.test(ticker)) {\n      return { ok: false, error: \"Ticker contains unsupported characters.\" };\n    }\n    return { ok: true };\n  }\n\n  if (step === \"date\") {\n    const date = String(values.date ?? \"\").trim();\n    if (!/^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/.test(date)) {\n      return { ok: false, error: \"Use YYYY-MM-DD.\" };\n    }\n    const parsed = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00`);\n    if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {\n      return { ok: false, error: \"Invalid date.\" };\n    }\n    const today = new Date();\n    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);\n    if (parsed > today) return { ok: false, error: \"Date cannot be in the future.\" };\n    return { ok: true };\n  }\n\n  if (step === \"analysts\") {\n    const analysts = Array.isArray(values.analysts) ? values.analysts : [];\n    return analysts.length > 0\n      ? { ok: true }\n      : { ok: false, error: \"Select at least one analyst.\" };\n  }\n\n  return { ok: true };\n}\n"

              "content": "import { createStore } from \"zustand/vanilla\";\n\nexport type RunStatus =\n  | \"idle\"\n  | \"starting\"\n  | \"running\"\n  | \"cancelling\"\n  | \"completed\"\n  | \"failed\"\n  | \"cancelled\";\n\nexport type Connection = \"idle\" | \"connecting\" | \"live\" | \"reconnecting\" | \"closed\";\n\nexport type RunMessage = {\n  id: string;\n  timestamp?: string;\n  type?: string;\n  content: string;\n};\n\nexport type RunEvent = {\n  run_id?: string;\n  seq: number;\n  type: string;\n  payload?: Record<string, unknown>;\n};\n\nexport type RunState = {\n  runId: string | null;\n  status: RunStatus;\n  connection: Connection;\n  lastSeq: number;\n  messages: RunMessage[];\n  sections: Record<string, string>;\n  signal?: string;\n  review: boolean;\n  error?: string;\n  applyEvent: (event: RunEvent) => void;\n  applySnapshot: (snapshot: Record<string, unknown>) => void;\n  setConnection: (connection: Connection) => void;\n  reset: () => void;\n};\n\nconst TERMINAL = new Set<RunStatus>([\"completed\", \"failed\", \"cancelled\"]);\n\nexport function createRunStore() {\n  return createStore<RunState>((set, get) => ({\n    runId: null,\n    status: \"idle\",\n    connection: \"idle\",\n    lastSeq: 0,\n    messages: [],\n    sections: {},\n    review: false,\n\n    applyEvent(event) {\n      const state = get();\n      if (typeof event.seq === \"number\" && event.seq <= state.lastSeq) return;\n      const payload = event.payload ?? {};\n      const patch: Partial<RunState> = { lastSeq: event.seq };\n\n      switch (event.type) {\n        case \"run.started\":\n          patch.status = \"running\";\n          patch.connection = \"live\";\n          break;\n        case \"message\":\n          patch.messages = [\n            ...state.messages,\n            {\n              id: `${event.run_id ?? \"run\"}:${event.seq}`,\n              timestamp: payload.timestamp as string | undefined,\n              type: payload.type as string | undefined,\n              content: String(payload.content ?? \"\"),\n            },\n          ];\n          break;\n        case \"report.section\":\n          patch.sections = {\n            ...state.sections,\n            [String(payload.section ?? \"\")]: String(payload.content ?? \"\"),\n          };\n          break;\n        case \"run.completed\":\n          patch.status = \"completed\";\n          patch.connection = \"closed\";\n          patch.signal = payload.signal as string | undefined;\n          patch.review = Boolean(payload.review);\n          break;\n        case \"run.failed\":\n          patch.status = \"failed\";\n          patch.connection = \"closed\";\n          patch.error = String(payload.message ?? \"run failed\");\n          break;\n        case \"run.cancelled\":\n          patch.status = \"cancelled\";\n          patch.connection = \"closed\";\n          break;\n        case \"snapshot\":\n          patch.status = (payload.status as RunStatus) ?? state.status;\n          patch.lastSeq = Number(payload.last_seq ?? event.seq);\n          patch.sections = (payload.sections as Record<string, string>) ?? state.sections;\n          patch.signal = payload.signal as string | undefined;\n          patch.review = Boolean(payload.review);\n          break;\n        default:\n          break;\n      }\n\n      if (patch.status && TERMINAL.has(patch.status)) {\n        patch.connection = \"closed\";\n      }\n      set(patch);\n    },\n\n    applySnapshot(snapshot) {\n      set({\n        runId: String(snapshot.run_id ?? \"\"),\n        status: (snapshot.status as RunStatus) ?? \"running\",\n        connection: \"connecting\",\n        lastSeq: Number(snapshot.last_seq ?? 0),\n        signal: snapshot.signal as string | undefined,\n        review: Boolean(snapshot.review),\n      });\n    },\n\n    setConnection(connection) {\n      set({ connection });\n    },\n\n    reset() {\n      set({\n        runId: null,\n        status: \"idle\",\n        connection: \"idle\",\n        lastSeq: 0,\n        messages: [],\n        sections: {},\n        signal: undefined,\n        review: false,\n        error: undefined,\n      });\n    },\n  }));\n}\n"

              "content": "export type RunConfig = {\n  defaults: Record<string, unknown>;\n  providers: Array<{ key: string; label: string; default_url: string | null }>;\n  env_locks: Record<string, boolean>;\n  key_status: Record<string, string>;\n  prefs: Record<string, unknown>;\n};\n\nexport type RunSnapshot = {\n  run_id: string;\n  status: string;\n  ticker: string;\n  trade_date: string;\n  last_seq: number;\n  signal?: string | null;\n  review: boolean;\n  warnings: string[];\n  error?: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n};\n\nlet csrfToken: string | null = null;\n\nexport async function getSessionToken(): Promise<string> {\n  if (csrfToken) return csrfToken;\n  const response = await fetch(\"/api/session\", { headers: { Accept: \"application/json\" } });\n  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`session failed: ${response.status}`);\n  const payload = (await response.json()) as { csrf_token: string };\n  csrfToken = payload.csrf_token;\n  return csrfToken;\n}\n\nasync function jsonRequest<T>(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {\n  const response = await fetch(url, init);\n  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`request failed: ${response.status}`);\n  return (await response.json()) as T;\n}\n\nexport function getRunConfig() {\n  return jsonRequest<RunConfig>(\"/api/config\");\n}\n\nexport function getRunModels(provider: string, mode: \"quick\" | \"deep\") {\n  return jsonRequest<{ models: Array<{ value: string; label: string }> }>(\n    `/api/config/models?provider=${encodeURIComponent(provider)}&mode=${mode}`,\n  );\n}\n\nexport async function startRun(body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<RunSnapshot> {\n  const token = await getSessionToken();\n  return jsonRequest<RunSnapshot>(\"/api/runs\", {\n    method: \"POST\",\n    headers: {\n      \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n      \"X-CSRF-Token\": token,\n    },\n    body: JSON.stringify(body),\n  });\n}\n\nexport function getRun(runId: string) {\n  return jsonRequest<RunSnapshot>(`/api/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`);\n}\n\nexport async function cancelRun(runId: string): Promise<RunSnapshot> {\n  const token = await getSessionToken();\n  return jsonRequest<RunSnapshot>(`/api/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}/cancel`, {\n    method: \"POST\",\n    headers: { \"X-CSRF-Token\": token },\n  });\n}\n\nexport function runEventsUrl(runId: string, afterSeq: number) {\n  return `/api/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}/events?after_seq=${afterSeq}`;\n}\n"
            },

exc.message : String(exc));\n    }\n  }\n\n  const status = state.status;\n  const canCancel = !TERMINAL.has(status);\n\n  return (\n    <main className=\"mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-10\">\n      <header className=\"mb-8 flex items-start justify-between gap-4\">\n        <div>\n          <Link className=\"text-sm text-cyan-300 hover:text-cyan-200\" to=\"/history\">\n            ← {t(\"nav.history\")}\n          </Link>\n          <h1 className=\"mt-3 text-3xl font-semibold text-slate-100\">\n            {t(\"live.title\")}\n          </h1>\n          <p className=\"mt-2 font-mono text-xs text-slate-400\">\n            {t(\"live.runId\")}: {runId} · {t(\"live.status\")}: {status} ·{\" \"}\n            {t(\"live.connection\")}: {state.connection}\n          </p>\n        </div>\n        <LanguageSwitch />\n      </header>\n\n      {state.review ? `iter_grid`、`run_backtest`、`summarize`。\n- `run_id` 可续跑；已完成的 cell 跳过。\n- 运行使用独立 `results_dir/backtest/<run_id>` 与独立 `trading_memory.md`，绝不写 live decision log。\n- 回测占用与单分析相同的单运行槽位；第二个任务 409。\n- **不提供 failed`；无 `cancelled`。\n- 进度：状态级 indeterminate；不做伪造 cell 进度。\n\n`GET /api/backtests`：只读已有 `results_dir/backtest/*` 列表。\n`GET /api/backtests/{run_id}`：状态/结果摘要；只读。\n\n### 公告契约\n\n`GET /api/announcements`\n\n- 服务端调用现有 `fetch_announcements`（超时 1s，失败回退）。\n- 60s 缓存；返回 `{announcements, require_attention}`。\n- 公告文本按不可信内容返回；前端纯文本/受限 Markdown。\n- `require_attention=true` 时前端阻塞确认。\n- 不返回任何路径、密钥、供应商信息。\n\n### 单运行槽位\n\n- `RunCoordinator` 扩展为支持 `kind: analysis | backtest`。\n- 回测 runner 通过同一 coordinator 占用槽位；分析运行期间提交回测返回 409，反之亦然。\n- 回测不写 analysis report tree；只写 backtest 目录与独立 memory log。\n\n---\n\n## 4. 前端设计\n\n### 回测页 `/backtest`\n\n- 表单：tickers、start、end、every、analysts、asset type、portfolio JSON（粘贴/上传）、run id。\n- 运行中：indeterminate 状态 + 预期 cell 数；**无取消按钮**，提示“回测会运行至完成，可用 run_id 续跑”。\n- 结果：Resolved/Pending/Unscored、按评级 n/命中率/均值 alpha、holding、failures、settlement failures、日志下载。\n- 历史回测列表：从只读 artifacts 读取，不提供删除。\n- 复用现有 `History` 报告/下载组件。\n\n### 公告\n\n- 顶部 banner；`require_attention` 用阻塞模态框。\n- 确认后继续；失败静默回退为链接。\n- 中英文 UI 文案；公告正文不翻译。\n\n### 路由/导航\n\n- `/backtest`、`/backtest/:runId`。\n- 主导航增加 Backtest。\n- 保持分析/历史页不变。\n\n---\n\n## 5. 依赖变更\n\n**无新增依赖。**\n\n- Python：复用 `run_backtest`、`summarize`、`fetch_announcements`。\n- 前端：复用现有 React Query、i18n、Markdown、Playwright、Vitest；不新增包。\n- 不修改 `pyproject.toml`。\n\n---\n\n## 6. 测试计划（待审批）\n\n### 6.1 回测正常流程\n\n- 参数解析与 回测失败/边界\n\n- 无效 ticker/date/every/analysts/asset type/portfolio → 422。\n- 空 tickers → 422。\n- 第二个回测/分析 → 409。\n- 未知 run_id → 404。\n- 回测中无 cancel 路由 → 404/405。\n- 回测执行异常 → failed 状态，live log 不变。\n- 回测结果不包含服务器路径。\n\n### 6.3 回测隔离\n\n- 启动回测前后 live `memory_log_path` 内容 hash 不变。\n- 回测日志只写 `results_dir/backtest/<run_id>/trading_memory.md`。\n- 历史页仍只读；不删除/不改写。\n- 回测 artifacts 不被分析运行读取为 past context。\n\n### 6.4 公告\n\n- 成功返回 announcements/require_attention。\n- 上游失败 → 回退文本，不阻塞。\n- `require_attention=true` → 前端阻塞确认。\n- HTML/脚本/危险链接不执行。\n- 不返回路径/密钥；缓存行为。\n\n### 6.5 权限/安全\n\n- 回测 POST 需要 CSRF；缺失/错误 → 403。\n- 非 loopback Host → 400；无 wildcard CORS。\n- 公告/回测响应无路径、密钥、堆栈。\n- 无执行/下单路由。\n- 单运行冲突。\n\n### 6.6 前端\n\n- 回测表单校验、结果表、无取消控件。\n- 公告 banner/模态、i18n key 对齐。\n- Vitest 组件测试。\n- Chromium Playwright：回测表单 → 运行 → 结果；公告展示/确认。\n- 不使用 Firefox/WebKit。\n\n### 6.7 兼容性\n\n- 核心/CLI 公共签名不变；核心/CLI 不 import `tradingagents_web`。\n- `tradingagents --help`、`backtest --help`、import smoke。\n- 现有 113 The browser never receives keys or server filesystem paths.\n22-7. Support Chinese/English UI switching, independent of the report output language.\n23-8. Keep the browser, HTTP surface, event stream, and frontend build isolated from the core.\n24-\n25-<a id=\"non-goals\"></a>\n26-## 3. Non-goals\n27-\n28-- Trading execution, order placement, position changes, or brokerage integration.\n29-- New data vendors, model providers, model catalogues, prompts, agents, or rating rules.\n30-- Multi-user accounts, tenants, billing, quotas, or authentication.\n31-- New databases, message queues, caches, or cross-process run persistence.\n32-- Cloud deployment, container orchestration, domain/TLS provisioning, or release automation.\n33-- PDF or Word export; native mobile applications.\n34:- Multi-ticker batch analysis outside the existing backtest command.\n35:- Cross-run comparison, scoring dashboards, or backtest charts in the first release.\n36-- Any change to CLI arguments, defaults, output, exit codes, or core behaviour.\n37-\n38-## 4. Baseline code facts that constrain the design\n39-\n40-| Fact | Evidence | Consequence |\n41-| --- | --- | --- |\n42-| Core configuration is a module-level singleton | `src/tradingagents/dataflows/config.py` (`_config`, `set_config`) | Two graphs with different configs must not run concurrently in one process. |\n43-| The CLI message buffer is a module-level singleton | `src/cli/main.py` (`message_buffer = MessageBuffer()`) | The web layer owns its own run state and does not reuse this object. |\n44-| The CLI streams the graph directly | `src/cli/main.py` (`run_analysis`, `graph.graph.stream`) | The CLI stream path is the behavioural reference for live updates. |\n45-| `propagate()` writes a state log | `src/tradingagents/graph/trading_graph.py` (`_log_state`) | API-style runs may have `full_states_log_*.json`; CLI-style runs do not. |\n46-| Decision memory is read-modify-write with atomic replacement | `src/tradingagents/agents/utils/memory.py` | Concurrent writers are not proven safe; the single-run rule protects the log. |\n47-| Checkpoints are per-ticker SQLite databases | `src/tradingagents/graph/checkpointer.py` | A run can resume only when checkpointing was enabled and the process is available. |\n48-| Report serialization is shared | `src/tradingagents/reporting.py` (`write_report_tree`) | The web layer calls this writer; it does not reimplement section layout. |\n49-| Path safety is deterministic | `src/tradingagents/dataflows/utils.py` (`safe_ticker_component`) | The web layer reuses it for every ticker/run-id path component. |\n50-| Rating extraction is deterministic | `src/tradingagents/agents/utils/rating.py` | The web layer does not infer or repair a rating. |\n51-| Portfolio states are distinct | `src/tradingagents/portfolio.py` | No portfolio, an empty book, and a populated book are three different inputs. |\n52:| Backtest is synchronous and has no cancellation hook | `src/tradingagents/backtest.py` (`run_backtest`) | The web layer does not pretend to cancel a backtest. |\n53-| Stats and wall-time helpers exist | `src/cli/stats_handler.py`, `src/tradingagents/graph/analyst_execution.py` | The web layer reuses them for live statistics and timing. |\n54-\n55-## 5. System context\n56-\n57-```\n58-Browser: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite SPA\n59-  |  same-origin REST (JSON)\n60-  |  same-origin SSE (text/event-stream)\n61-  v\n62-FastAPI + Uvicorn (single worker, 127.0.0.1)\n63-  |-- Security middleware: Host / Origin / CSRF / CSP / size limit\n64-  |-- Configuration projection (read-only)\n65-  |-- Run coordinator (single active run, worker thread bridge)\n66-  |-- Event projection and bounded SSE buffer\n67-  |-- Artifact read model (hash identifiers, read-only)\n68-  |-- Backtest surface\n69-  v\n70-Existing public Python interfaces and on-disk artifacts\n71-  |-- TradingAgentsGraph (public methods)\n72:  |-- run_backtest / summarize\n73-  |-- write_report_tree\n74-  |-- TradingMemoryLog (through existing graph methods)\n75-  |-- results_dir, checkpoint directory, CLI preferences\n76-```\n77-\n78-The browser never imports Python, never receives a server path, and never receives a secret. The core and CLI never import the web layer.\n79-\n80-## 6. Logical components\n81-\n82-<a id=\"w1-entry-and-parameter-surface\"></a>\n83-### 6.1 W1 — Entry and parameter surface\n84-\n85-Owned by `src/tradingagents_web/api/config.py`, `api/runs.py`, `models/requests.py`, and the frontend wizard.\n86-\n87-Responsibility: render the eight selection steps, validate inputs, and submit a run request.\n88-\n89-Inputs: ticker, analysis date, output language, analyst selection, research depth, provider and endpoint, quick/deep model, provider thinking parameters, checkpoint flag, portfolio JSON, and the announcement acknowledgement.\n90-\n91-Outputs: a validated run request or a field-level error.\n92-\n93-Rules:\n94-- Validation mirrors the CLI and core rules; the core remains authoritative.\n95-- The provider/API-key step displays `configured / not_configured / not_required` from the server environment and never accepts a key.\n96-- Environment-locked values are shown as locked with their source, matching the CLI's \"from environment\" messages.\n97-- Crypto detection filters out the fundamentals analyst, matching `filter_analysts_for_asset_type`.\n98-- The request accepts only the allowlisted fields; the client cannot submit a config dictionary or a filesystem path.\n99-\n100-Failure modes: invalid ticker, future date, no analyst, unknown provider/model, invalid portfolio, missing server key (allowed to start, fails at the first provider call).\n101-\n102-<a id=\"w2-run-coordinator\"></a>\n103-### 6.2 W2 — Run coordinator\n104-\n105-Owned by `src/tradingagents_web/runtime/coordinator.py`, `runtime/graph_runner.py`, and `runtime/artifacts_writer.py`.\n106-\n107-Responsibility: own the lifecycle of the single active analysis run.\n108-\n109-Inputs: a validated run request.\n110-Outputs: a run record, an ordered event sequence, and final artifacts.\n111-\n112-Ownership:\n--\n162:| `backtest.progress` | optional, cells done/expected |\n163:| `backtest.completed` | structured summary |\n164-\n165-Rules:\n166-- Events are ordered by `seq`; reattachment replays from the last sequence.\n167-- The stream is one-way. Client actions use REST endpoints.\n168-- Payloads contain no secrets, absolute paths, stack traces, or raw credentials.\n169-- The buffer is bounded by count and approximate bytes; an overflow sends a snapshot.\n170-- Each subscriber has a bounded queue; a slow subscriber is dropped to snapshot mode.\n171-- Heartbeat is an SSE comment every 15 seconds.\n172-\n173-<a id=\"w5-artifact-read-model\"></a>\n174-### 6.5 W5 — Artifact read model\n175-\n176-Owned by `src/tradingagents_web/artifacts/index.py`, `artifacts/readers.py`, and `artifacts/downloads.py`.\n177-\n178-Sources:\n179-- Run directory: `<results_dir>/<ticker>/<date>/` with `message_tool.log` and `reports/*.md`.\n180-- API-style state log: `<results_dir>/<ticker>/TradingAgentsStrategy_logs/full_states_log_<date>.json` when present.\n181-- Saved report tree: `<results_dir>/reports/<ticker>_<timestamp>/` with `1_analysts` … `5_portfolio` and `complete_report.md`.\n182:- Backtest run: `<results_dir>/backtest/<run_id>/` and its `trading_memory.md`.\n183-- Decision memory: `~/.tradingagents/memory/trading_memory.md`, read-only.\n184-\n185-Rules:\n186-- Read-only. No deletion, rotation, migration, or index database.\n187-- `artifact_id = sha256(relative_path)[:16]`; the server builds the id-to-path map on scan and never persists it.\n188-- Every identifier resolves through a validated root allowlist and `safe_ticker_component`.\n189-- Missing optional artifacts are reported as absent, not synthesized.\n190-- History works for CLI-style runs that lack `full_states_log_*.json`.\n191-- Scan limits: at most 500 runs, 50 per page, bounded report size.\n192-\n193:<a id=\"w6-backtest-surface\"></a>\n194:### 6.6 W6 — Backtest surface\n195-\n196:Owned by `src/tradingagents_web/api/backtests.py` and `runtime/backtest_runner.py`.\n197-\n198-Rules:\n199-- Parameters mirror the CLI: tickers, start, end, every, analysts, asset type, portfolio, run id.\n200-- The summary mirrors `summarize(...)`: resolved, pending, unscored, per-rating count/hit rate/mean alpha, holding window, failures, settlement failures.\n201-- The response does not include `log_path`; it includes an artifact id for the log.\n202:- Backtest and live analysis remain isolated. The web layer does not point a backtest at the live memory log.\n203:- A backtest is a run for the single-active-run rule.\n204:- **Backtest cancellation is not offered.** `run_backtest` has no cancellation hook; the UI must not claim otherwise. Analysis cancellation is unaffected. A backtest can be resumed with `run_id` after an interruption.\n205-\n206-<a id=\"w7-security-boundary\"></a>\n207-### 6.7 W7 — Security boundary\n208-\n209-Owned by `src/tradingagents_web/security.py`, `errors.py`, and the frontend renderer. The full permission matrix is in `docs/architecture/permission-model.md`.\n210-\n211-1. **Network**: bind to `127.0.0.1` only. Reject non-loopback `Host` headers. No authentication by confirmed scope; loopback, Host, Origin, and CSRF checks are mandatory compensating controls.\n212-2. **Secrets**: provider keys come only from the server environment. The browser receives status only. Errors and events are redacted.\n213-3. **Paths**: the browser receives artifact identifiers, not filesystem paths. Resolution uses `safe_ticker_component` and a root allowlist.\n214-4. **Untrusted content**: model output, tool output, announcements, and artifact text are data. Render as escaped text or a sanitized Markdown subset. No raw HTML, no script execution, no `javascript:` or `data:` links, no server-side template evaluation.\n215-5. **Requests**: state-changing requests require a CSRF token and a same-origin signal; no wildcard CORS. Body size is bounded.\n216-6. **Files**: no generic file browser, upload-to-server-path, or download-by-path endpoint. Portfolio uploads are read as text, validated, and discarded.\n217-7. **Logging**: no keys, cookies, authorization headers, absolute paths, or third-party prompt content.\n218-8. **Headers**: CSP, `X-Content-Type-Options`, `Referrer-Policy`, `Permissions-Policy`, `frame-ancestors 'none'`.\n219-\n220-<a id=\"w8-frontend\"></a>\n221-### 6.8 W8 — Frontend\n222-\n223-Owned by `src/tradingagents_web/frontend/` (source) and `src/tradingagents_web/static/` (build output).\n224-\n225-Stack: React 19, TypeScript strict, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui (Radix primitives), Lucide, Zustand, TanStack Query, React Router, react-i18next, React Hook Form + Zod, react-markdown + remark-gfm + rehype-sanitize.\n226-\n227-Rules:\n228-- UI state derives from server events and snapshots; the frontend does not compute ratings or business decisions.\n229-- The live view mirrors the TUI information set and adds a section switcher and full-content detail drawer.\n230-- The report view mirrors sections I–V and the complete report.\n231:- History and backtest views are read-only.\n232-- Chinese/English strings are UI-only; report content follows the existing output-language setting.\n233-- The app reconnects with a snapshot and an SSE `after_seq`.\n234-- No raw HTML, no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` for untrusted content, no external images by default.\n235-\n236-## 7. Module ownership and dependency direction\n237-\n238-<a id=\"proposed-ownership-paths\"></a>\n239-### 7.1 Ownership paths (approved for documentation)\n240-\n241-| Element | Path | Owns |\n242-| --- | --- | --- |\n243-| Web package | `src/tradingagents_web/` | Presentation-only package; never imported by core or CLI. |\n244-| App and entry | `app.py`, `cli.py`, `settings.py` | App factory, argparse/uvicorn, limits. |\n245-| Security | `security.py`, `errors.py` | Host/Origin/CSRF/CSP, error taxonomy, redaction. |\n246:| API | `api/session.py`, `api/config.py`, `api/announcements.py`, `api/runs.py`, `api/history.py`, `api/backtests.py` | HTTP contracts and validation. |\n247:| Runtime | `runtime/coordinator.py`, `graph_runner.py`, `backtest_runner.py`, `projector.py`, `event_buffer.py`, `artifacts_writer.py` | Run lifecycle, thread bridge, events, artifact writes. |\n248-| Artifacts | `artifacts/index.py`, `readers.py`, `downloads.py` | Read-only scan, parsing, downloads. |\n249-| Models | `models/requests.py`, `responses.py`, `events.py` | Pydantic request/response/event schemas. |\n250-| Frontend source | `frontend/` | React/TS source, i18n, tests. |\n251-| Build output | `static/` | Generated assets; not committed. |\n252-| Offline tests | `test/offline/test_web_*.py` | Deterministic contract/security/behavior tests. |\n253-| Live tests | `test/live/test_web_live.py` | Requires external-service and cost authorization. |\n254-\n255-### 7.2 Dependency direction\n256-\n257-| From | To | Allowed | Notes |\n258-| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n259-| `tradingagents_web` | `tradingagents` | Yes | Public core interfaces only for business semantics. |\n260-| `tradingagents_web` | `cli` | Yes, restricted | Reuse provider/model/prefs/stats helpers; no CLI global state mutation. |\n261-| `tradingagents` | `tradingagents_web` | **No** | Core must not depend on presentation. |\n262-| `cli` | `tradingagents_web` | **No** | CLI must not depend on presentation. |\n263-| Frontend | `/api` | Yes | No direct Python, filesystem, or provider access. |\n264-| `tradingagents_web` | DB/MQ/broker | **No** | No new persistence or messaging. |\n265-\n266-## 8. Interface contracts\n267-\n"
